summary: The note explains competitive analysis for local SMEs, using two case studies, FreshLocal (organic meal kits) and TechSphere (software). It covers tracking competitors, using technology tools, gathering direct customer feedback, following a structured framework, adapting continuously, and forming partnerships. It concludes that competitive analysis is an ongoing process that also produces societal benefits.
one_line: Local SMEs like FreshLocal and TechSphere use ongoing competitive analysis, technology, customer feedback and partnerships to succeed in crowded markets.
key_facts: Competitive analysis is the process of identifying competitors and evaluating their strategies to determine strengths and weaknesses relative to your own product or service.
FreshLocal was founded by Sarah Thompson in late 2023 and targeted the local organic food market.
Thompson set up a team solely devoted to competitor tracking, scrutinizing sales data, market trends and customer feedback.
FreshLocal identified a gap for affordable organic home-delivery meal kits and became a household name by mid-2024.
TechSphere was launched in November 2023 by Rajiv Patel and delivers unique software solutions for local businesses.
TechSphere used social media tracking tools, online forums and a competitive matrix to monitor competitors' new features.
In January 2024 FreshLocal invested in a tool to track its search engine rankings versus competitors for key industry terms.
FreshLocal holds monthly tasting events for customer feedback, while TechSphere runs open beta testing for new software.
FreshLocal's analysis covered product quality, customer service and marketing efficiency; TechSphere's covered technological assets, innovation speed and market responsiveness.
FreshLocal introduced plant-based options and TechSphere moved into cloud services as examples of adaptation.
In its second year FreshLocal partnered with local fitness centers to offer member-exclusive meal plans.
TechSphere allied with academic institutions to leverage research for its development pipeline.
GadgetGurus is a local tech startup that surfaced on October 5, 2023, cited as a business using competitive analysis to find market gaps.
